CREATE TABLE checkpoints ( checkpoint_id TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL, root_session_id TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL, captured_at_us BIGINT NOT NULL, digest TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL, pinned BOOLEAN DEFAULT false NOT NULL, created_reason TEXT COLLATE "C" DEFAULT ? NOT NULL, checkpoint_text TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (checkpoint_id), UNIQUE (digest) )
CREATE INDEX checkpoint_root_time ON checkpoints (root_session_id, captured_at_us, checkpoint_id)

CREATE TABLE sessions ( session_id TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL, created_at_us BIGINT, latest_invocation_id TEXT COLLATE "C", durable_sequence BIGINT NOT NULL, history_start_sequence BIGINT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (session_id), CHECK (durable_sequence >= ?), CHECK (history_start_sequence >= ?) )

CREATE TABLE checkpoints ( checkpoint_id TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL, root_session_id TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL, captured_at_us BIGINT NOT NULL, digest TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL, pinned BOOLEAN DEFAULT false NOT NULL, created_reason TEXT COLLATE "C" DEFAULT ? CREATE TABLE sessions ( session_id TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL, created_at_us BIGINT, latest_invocation_id TEXT COLLATE "C", durable_sequence BIGINT NOT NULL, history_start_sequence BIGINT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (session_id), CHECK (durable_sequence >= ?), CHECK (history_start_sequence >= ?) )

CREATE TABLE operator_definitions ( definition_id TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL, operator_id TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL, version TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL, definition_text TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (definition_id) )

CREATE TABLE user_events ( event_id TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL, session_id TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL, invocation_id TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL, sequence BIGINT NOT NULL, kind TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL, occurrence_id TEXT COLLATE "C", occurred_at_us BIGINT NOT NULL, payload_text TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (event_id), UNIQUE (invocation_id, sequence), CHECK (sequence >= ?) )

CREATE TABLE checkpoints ( checkpoint_id TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL, root_session_id TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL, captured_at_us BIGINT NOT NULL, digest TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL, pinned BOOLEAN DEFAULT false NOT NULL, created_reason TEXT COLLATE "C" DEFAULT ? NOT NULL, checkpoint_text TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (checkpoint_id), UNIQUE (digest) )

CREATE TABLE sessions ( session_id TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL, created_at_us BIGINT, latest_invocation_id TEXT COLLATE "C", durable_sequence BIGINT NOT NULL, history_start_sequence BIGINT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (session_id), CHECK (durable_sequence >= ?), CHECK (history_start_sequence >= ?) )

CREATE TABLE artifact_dependencies ( parent_hash TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL, slot INTEGER NOT NULL, path TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL, child_hash TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (parent_hash, slot), CHECK (slot >= ?), CHECK (parent_hash <> child_hash), FOREIGN KEY(parent_hash) REFERENCES artifacts (hash), FOREIGN KEY(child_hash) REFERENCES artifacts (hash) )
CREATE INDEX artifact_dep_child ON artifact_dependencies (child_hash)

CREATE TABLE artifact_refs ( owner_kind TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL, owner_id TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL, slot INTEGER NOT NULL, path TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL, artifact_hash TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (owner_kind, owner_id, slot), CHECK (owner_kind IN (?,?,?,?,?)), CHECK (slot >= ?), FOREIGN KEY(artifact_hash) REFERENCES artifacts (hash) )

CREATE TABLE runtime_events ( event_id TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL, session_id TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL, invocation_id TEXT COLLATE "C", sequence BIGINT NOT NULL, event_name TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL, occurred_at_us BIGINT NOT NULL, store_order BIGINT NOT NULL, schema_version INTEGER NOT NULL, operator_definition_id TEXT COLLATE "C", payload_text TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL, delta_text TEXT COLLATE "C", PRIMARY KEY (event_id), UNIQUE (session_id, sequence), UNIQUE (store_order), CHECK (sequence >= ?), CHECK (store_order >= ?), CHECK (operator_definition_id IS NULL OR event_name IN (?,?)), FOREIGN KEY(operator_definition_id) REFERENCES operator_definitions (definition_id) )

CREATE TABLE persistence_meta ( id INTEGER NOT NULL, format_version INTEGER NOT NULL, projection_version INTEGER NOT NULL, last_store_order INTEGER NOT NULL, store_id TEXT COLLATE "BINARY" NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (id), CHECK (id = ?) )

CREATE TABLE artifacts ( hash TEXT COLLATE "BINARY" NOT NULL, value_type TEXT COLLATE "BINARY" NOT NULL, logical_bytes INTEGER NOT NULL, body BLOB NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (hash), CHECK (value_type IN (?,?,?)), CHECK (logical_bytes >= ?) )

CREATE TABLE workflow_revisions ( revision_id TEXT COLLATE "BINARY" NOT NULL, workflow_id TEXT COLLATE "BINARY" NOT NULL, workflow_version TEXT COLLATE "BINARY" NOT NULL, definition_hash TEXT COLLATE "BINARY" NOT NULL, registered_at_us INTEGER NOT NULL, snapshot_text TEXT COLLATE "BINARY" NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (revision_id) )
CREATE INDEX workflow_history ON workflow_revisions (workflow_id, registered_at_us, revision_id)

CREATE TABLE operator_definitions ( definition_id TEXT COLLATE "BINARY" NOT NULL, operator_id TEXT COLLATE "BINARY" NOT NULL, version TEXT COLLATE "BINARY" NOT NULL, definition_text TEXT COLLATE "BINARY" NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (definition_id) )
CREATE INDEX operator_versions ON operator_definitions (operator_id, version, definition_id)

CREATE TABLE user_events ( event_id TEXT COLLATE "BINARY" NOT NULL, session_id TEXT COLLATE "BINARY" NOT NULL, invocation_id TEXT COLLATE "BINARY" NOT NULL, sequence INTEGER NOT NULL, kind TEXT COLLATE "BINARY" NOT NULL, occurrence_id TEXT COLLATE "BINARY", occurred_at_us INTEGER NOT NULL, payload_text TEXT COLLATE "BINARY" NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (event_id), UNIQUE (invocation_id, sequence), CHECK (sequence >= ?) )
CREATE INDEX user_occurrence_seq ON user_events (invocation_id, occurrence_id, sequence)

CREATE TABLE checkpoints ( checkpoint_id TEXT COLLATE "BINARY" NOT NULL, root_session_id TEXT COLLATE "BINARY" NOT NULL, captured_at_us INTEGER NOT NULL, digest TEXT COLLATE "BINARY" NOT NULL, pinned BOOLEAN DEFAULT ? NOT NULL, created_reason TEXT COLLATE "BINARY" DEFAULT ? NOT NULL, checkpoint_text TEXT COLLATE "BINARY" NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (checkpoint_id), UNIQUE (digest) )
CREATE INDEX checkpoint_root_time ON checkpoints (root_session_id, captured_at_us, checkpoint_id)

CREATE TABLE sessions ( session_id TEXT COLLATE "BINARY" NOT NULL, created_at_us INTEGER, latest_invocation_id TEXT COLLATE "BINARY", durable_sequence INTEGER NOT NULL, history_start_sequence INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (session_id), CHECK (durable_sequence >= ?), CHECK (history_start_sequence >= ?) )

CREATE TABLE artifact_dependencies ( parent_hash TEXT COLLATE "BINARY" NOT NULL, slot INTEGER NOT NULL, path TEXT COLLATE "BINARY" NOT NULL, child_hash TEXT COLLATE "BINARY" NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (parent_hash, slot), CHECK (slot >= ?), CHECK (parent_hash <> child_hash), FOREIGN KEY(parent_hash) REFERENCES artifacts (hash), FOREIGN KEY(child_hash) REFERENCES artifacts (hash) )
CREATE INDEX artifact_dep_child ON artifact_dependencies (child_hash)

CREATE TABLE artifact_refs ( owner_kind TEXT COLLATE "BINARY" NOT NULL, owner_id TEXT COLLATE "BINARY" NOT NULL, slot INTEGER NOT NULL, path TEXT COLLATE "BINARY" NOT NULL, artifact_hash TEXT COLLATE "BINARY" NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (owner_kind, owner_id, slot), CHECK (owner_kind IN (?,?,?,?,?)), CHECK (slot >= ?), FOREIGN KEY(artifact_hash) REFERENCES artifacts (hash) )
CREATE INDEX artifact_ref_hash ON artifact_refs (artifact_hash)

CREATE TABLE runtime_events ( event_id TEXT COLLATE "BINARY" NOT NULL, session_id TEXT COLLATE "BINARY" NOT NULL, invocation_id TEXT COLLATE "BINARY", sequence INTEGER NOT NULL, event_name TEXT COLLATE "BINARY" NOT NULL, occurred_at_us INTEGER NOT NULL, store_order INTEGER NOT NULL, schema_version INTEGER NOT NULL, operator_definition_id TEXT COLLATE "BINARY", payload_text TEXT COLLATE "BINARY" NOT NULL, delta_text TEXT COLLATE "BINARY", PRIMARY KEY (event_id), UNIQUE (session_id, sequence), UNIQUE (store_order), CHECK (sequence >= ?), CHECK (store_order >= ?), CHECK (operator_definition_id IS NULL OR event_name IN (?,?)), FOREIGN KEY(operator_definition_id) REFERENCES operator_definitions (definition_id) )
CREATE INDEX runtime_invocation_order ON runtime_events (invocation_id, store_order)
CREATE INDEX runtime_invocation_seq ON runtime_events (invocation_id, sequence)

CREATE TABLE checkpoint_sessions ( checkpoint_id TEXT COLLATE "BINARY" NOT NULL, session_id TEXT COLLATE "BINARY" NOT NULL, invocation_id TEXT COLLATE "BINARY", workflow_revision_id TEXT COLLATE "BINARY", sequence INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (checkpoint_id, session_id), CHECK (sequence >= ?), FOREIGN KEY(checkpoint_id) REFERENCES checkpoints (checkpoint_id), FOREIGN KEY(workflow_revision_id) REFERENCES workflow_revisions (revision_id) )
CREATE INDEX checkpoint_session_position ON checkpoint_sessions (session_id, sequence, checkpoint_id)

CREATE TABLE invocations ( invocation_id TEXT COLLATE "BINARY" NOT NULL, updated_store_order INTEGER NOT NULL, session_id TEXT COLLATE "BINARY" NOT NULL, workflow_revision_id TEXT COLLATE "BINARY" NOT NULL, entry_node_id TEXT COLLATE "BINARY" NOT NULL, status TEXT COLLATE "BINARY", pending_outcome TEXT COLLATE "BINARY", control_state TEXT COLLATE "BINARY", recovery_count INTEGER, last_recovery_id TEXT COLLATE "BINARY", recovery_pending BOOLEAN, started_at_us INTEGER, completed_at_us INTEGER, last_sequence INTEGER NOT NULL, root_invocation_id TEXT COLLATE "BINARY" NOT NULL, parent_invocation_id TEXT COLLATE "BINARY", parent_occurrence_id TEXT COLLATE "BINARY", creation_id TEXT COLLATE "BINARY", unit_index INTEGER, ownership_phase TEXT COLLATE "BINARY", input_ref JSON, output_ref JSON, error_ref JSON, error_type TEXT COLLATE "BINARY", error_code TEXT COLLATE "BINARY", PRIMARY KEY (invocation_id), CHECK (status IS NULL OR status IN (?,?,?,?,?,?,?)), CHECK (pending_outcome IS NULL OR pending_outcome IN (?,?,?)), CHECK (ownership_phase IS NULL OR ownership_phase IN (?,?,?,?,?)), CHECK (unit_index IS NULL OR unit_index >= ?), CHECK ((parent_invocation_id IS NULL AND parent_occurrence_id IS NULL AND creation_id IS NULL AND unit_index IS NULL AND ownership_phase IS NULL) OR (parent_invocation_id IS NOT NULL AND parent_occurrence_id IS NOT NULL AND creation_id IS NOT NULL AND unit_index IS NOT NULL AND ownership_phase IS NOT NULL)), CHECK (parent_invocation_id IS NOT NULL OR root_invocation_id = invocation_id), UNIQUE (parent_invocation_id, creation_id, unit_index), FOREIGN KEY(root_invocation_id) REFERENCES invocations (invocation_id), CONSTRAINT fk_invocation_parent_occurrence FOREIGN KEY(parent_invocation_id, parent_occurrence_id) REFERENCES node_executions (invocation_id, occurrence_id), FOREIGN KEY(session_id) REFERENCES sessions (session_id), FOREIGN KEY(workflow_revision_id) REFERENCES workflow_revisions (revision_id) )
CREATE INDEX invocation_session_time ON invocations (session_id, started_at_us, invocation_id)
CREATE INDEX invocation_root_update ON invocations (root_invocation_id, updated_store_order)
CREATE INDEX invocation_workflow_time ON invocations (workflow_revision_id, started_at_us, invocation_id)
CREATE INDEX invocation_parent ON invocations (parent_invocation_id, unit_index, invocation_id)
CREATE INDEX invocation_root ON invocations (root_invocation_id, invocation_id)
CREATE INDEX invocation_status_time ON invocations (status, started_at_us, invocation_id)

CREATE TABLE node_executions ( invocation_id TEXT COLLATE "BINARY" NOT NULL, occurrence_id TEXT COLLATE "BINARY" NOT NULL, updated_store_order INTEGER NOT NULL, ordinal INTEGER NOT NULL, activations JSON NOT NULL, node_id TEXT COLLATE "BINARY" NOT NULL, scope JSON NOT NULL, status TEXT COLLATE "BINARY" NOT NULL, phase TEXT COLLATE "BINARY", ready_at_us INTEGER, started_at_us INTEGER, completed_at_us INTEGER, recovery_attempts INTEGER NOT NULL, input_ref JSON, output_ref JSON, metrics_ref JSON, error_ref JSON, error_type TEXT COLLATE "BINARY", error_code TEXT COLLATE "BINARY", error_phase TEXT COLLATE "BINARY", PRIMARY KEY (invocation_id, occurrence_id), CHECK (status IN (?,?,?,?,?,?,?)), CHECK (recovery_attempts >= ?), FOREIGN KEY(invocation_id) REFERENCES invocations (invocation_id) )
CREATE INDEX node_statistics ON node_executions (node_id, status, started_at_us, invocation_id)
CREATE INDEX node_updates ON node_executions (invocation_id, updated_store_order)
CREATE INDEX node_ordinal ON node_executions (invocation_id, node_id, ordinal)

CREATE TABLE graph_changes ( event_id TEXT COLLATE "BINARY" NOT NULL, change_index INTEGER NOT NULL, session_id TEXT COLLATE "BINARY" NOT NULL, invocation_id TEXT COLLATE "BINARY" NOT NULL, sequence INTEGER NOT NULL, store_order INTEGER NOT NULL, occurred_at_us INTEGER NOT NULL, entity_type TEXT COLLATE "BINARY" NOT NULL, entity_id TEXT COLLATE "BINARY" NOT NULL, change JSON NOT NULL, duration_ns INTEGER, error_type TEXT COLLATE "BINARY", error_code TEXT COLLATE "BINARY", PRIMARY KEY (event_id, change_index), CHECK (entity_type IN (?,?,?,?,?)), CHECK (change_index >= ?), CHECK (duration_ns IS NULL OR duration_ns >= ?), FOREIGN KEY(event_id) REFERENCES runtime_events (event_id), FOREIGN KEY(invocation_id) REFERENCES invocations (invocation_id) )
CREATE INDEX graph_updates ON graph_changes (invocation_id, store_order, change_index)
CREATE INDEX graph_entity_history ON graph_changes (invocation_id, entity_type, entity_id, sequence, change_index)
CREATE INDEX graph_replay ON graph_changes (invocation_id, sequence, change_index)
CREATE INDEX graph_edge_order ON graph_changes (invocation_id, JSON_EXTRACT(change, ?), store_order)

CREATE TABLE operator_calls ( invocation_id TEXT COLLATE "BINARY" NOT NULL, call_id TEXT COLLATE "BINARY" NOT NULL, updated_store_order INTEGER NOT NULL, occurrence_id TEXT COLLATE "BINARY" NOT NULL, operator_id TEXT COLLATE "BINARY" NOT NULL, operator_definition_id TEXT COLLATE "BINARY", unit_index INTEGER NOT NULL, status TEXT COLLATE "BINARY" NOT NULL, started_at_us INTEGER NOT NULL, completed_at_us INTEGER, queue_duration_ns INTEGER NOT NULL, execution_duration_ns INTEGER, input_ref JSON, output_ref JSON, error_ref JSON, error_type TEXT COLLATE "BINARY", error_code TEXT COLLATE "BINARY", PRIMARY KEY (invocation_id, call_id), FOREIGN KEY(invocation_id, occurrence_id) REFERENCES node_executions (invocation_id, occurrence_id), CHECK (status IN (?,?,?,?,?)), CHECK (unit_index >= ?), CHECK (queue_duration_ns >= ?), CHECK (execution_duration_ns IS NULL OR execution_duration_ns >= ?), FOREIGN KEY(invocation_id) REFERENCES invocations (invocation_id), FOREIGN KEY(operator_definition_id) REFERENCES operator_definitions (definition_id) )
CREATE INDEX call_occurrence ON operator_calls (invocation_id, occurrence_id, unit_index)
CREATE INDEX operator_statistics ON operator_calls (operator_id, status, started_at_us, invocation_id)
CREATE INDEX call_updates ON operator_calls (invocation_id, updated_store_order)

CREATE TABLE waits ( invocation_id TEXT COLLATE "BINARY" NOT NULL, wait_id TEXT COLLATE "BINARY" NOT NULL, updated_store_order INTEGER NOT NULL, occurrence_id TEXT COLLATE "BINARY" NOT NULL, kind TEXT COLLATE "BINARY" NOT NULL, status TEXT COLLATE "BINARY" NOT NULL, created_at_us INTEGER NOT NULL, resumed_at_us INTEGER, deadline_at_us INTEGER, request_ref JSON, response_ref JSON, PRIMARY KEY (invocation_id, wait_id), FOREIGN KEY(invocation_id, occurrence_id) REFERENCES node_executions (invocation_id, occurrence_id), CHECK (status IN (?,?,?)), FOREIGN KEY(invocation_id) REFERENCES invocations (invocation_id) )
CREATE INDEX invocation_wait_status ON waits (invocation_id, status, wait_id)
CREATE INDEX wait_updates ON waits (invocation_id, updated_store_order)
CREATE INDEX wait_deadline ON waits (status, deadline_at_us, invocation_id)

CREATE TABLE edge_evaluations ( event_id TEXT COLLATE "BINARY" NOT NULL, result_index INTEGER NOT NULL, invocation_id TEXT COLLATE "BINARY" NOT NULL, source_occurrence_id TEXT COLLATE "BINARY" NOT NULL, edge_id TEXT COLLATE "BINARY" NOT NULL, source_status TEXT COLLATE "BINARY" NOT NULL, condition_result BOOLEAN NOT NULL, duration_ns INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (event_id, result_index), CHECK (source_status IN (?,?)), CHECK (result_index >= ?), CHECK (duration_ns >= ?), FOREIGN KEY(invocation_id, source_occurrence_id) REFERENCES node_executions (invocation_id, occurrence_id), FOREIGN KEY(event_id) REFERENCES runtime_events (event_id), FOREIGN KEY(invocation_id) REFERENCES invocations (invocation_id) )
CREATE INDEX edge_statistics ON edge_evaluations (edge_id, source_status, invocation_id)
CREATE INDEX edge_source_lookup ON edge_evaluations (invocation_id, source_occurrence_id, source_status)

CREATE TABLE operator_definitions ( definition_id TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL, operator_id TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL, version TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL, definition_text TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (definition_id) )

CREATE TABLE user_events ( event_id TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL, session_id TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL, invocation_id TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL, sequence BIGINT NOT NULL, kind TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL, occurrence_id TEXT COLLATE "C", occurred_at_us BIGINT NOT NULL, payload_text TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (event_id), UNIQUE (invocation_id, sequence), CHECK (sequence >= ?) )

CREATE TABLE checkpoints ( checkpoint_id TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL, root_session_id TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL, captured_at_us BIGINT NOT NULL, digest TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL, pinned BOOLEAN DEFAULT false NOT NULL, created_reason TEXT COLLATE "C" DEFAULT ? NOT NULL, checkpoint_text TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (checkpoint_id), UNIQUE (digest) )
CREATE INDEX checkpoint_root_time ON checkpoints (root_session_id, captured_at_us, checkpoint_id)

CREATE TABLE sessions ( session_id TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL, created_at_us BIGINT, latest_invocation_id TEXT COLLATE "C", durable_sequence BIGINT NOT NULL, history_start_sequence BIGINT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (session_id), CHECK (durable_sequence >= ?), CHECK (history_start_sequence >= ?) )

CREATE INDEX invocation_root_update ON invocations (root_invocation_id, updated_store_order)

CREATE TABLE persistence_meta ( id INTEGER NOT NULL, format_version INTEGER NOT NULL, projection_version INTEGER NOT NULL, last_store_order INTEGER NOT NULL, store_id TEXT COLLATE "BINARY" NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (id), CHECK (id = ?) )

CREATE TABLE artifacts ( hash TEXT COLLATE "BINARY" NOT NULL, value_type TEXT COLLATE "BINARY" NOT NULL, logical_bytes INTEGER NOT NULL, body BLOB NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (hash), CHECK (value_type IN (?,?,?)), CHECK (logical_bytes >= ?) )

CREATE TABLE operator_definitions ( definition_id TEXT COLLATE "BINARY" NOT NULL, operator_id TEXT COLLATE "BINARY" NOT NULL, version TEXT COLLATE "BINARY" NOT NULL, definition_text TEXT COLLATE "BINARY" NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (definition_id) )

CREATE INDEX user_occurrence_seq ON user_events (invocation_id, occurrence_id, sequence)

CREATE TABLE checkpoints ( checkpoint_id TEXT COLLATE "BINARY" NOT NULL, root_session_id TEXT COLLATE "BINARY" NOT NULL, captured_at_us INTEGER NOT NULL, digest TEXT COLLATE "BINARY" NOT NULL, pinned BOOLEAN DEFAULT ? NOT NULL, created_reason TEXT COLLATE "BINARY" DEFAULT ? NOT NULL, checkpoint_text TEXT COLLATE "BINARY" NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (checkpoint_id), UNIQUE (digest) )
CREATE INDEX checkpoint_root_time ON checkpoints (root_session_id, captured_at_us, checkpoint_id)

CREATE TABLE sessions ( session_id TEXT COLLATE "BINARY" NOT NULL, created_at_us INTEGER, latest_invocation_id TEXT COLLATE "BINARY", durable_sequence INTEGER NOT NULL, history_start_sequence INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (session_id), CHECK (durable_sequence >= ?), CHECK (history_start_sequence >= ?) )

CREATE TABLE persistence_meta ( id INTEGER NOT NULL, format_version INTEGER NOT NULL, projection_version INTEGER NOT NULL, last_store_order INTEGER NOT NULL, store_id TEXT COLLATE "BINARY" NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (id), CHECK (id = ?) )

CREATE TABLE artifacts ( hash TEXT COLLATE "BINARY" NOT NULL, value_type TEXT COLLATE "BINARY" NOT NULL, logical_bytes INTEGER NOT NULL, body BLOB NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (hash), CHECK (value_type IN (?,?,?)), CHECK (logical_bytes >= ?) )

CREATE TABLE workflow_revisions ( revision_id TEXT COLLATE "BINARY" NOT NULL, workflow_id TEXT COLLATE "BINARY" NOT NULL, workflow_version TEXT COLLATE "BINARY" NOT NULL, definition_hash TEXT COLLATE "BINARY" NOT NULL, registered_at_us INTEGER NOT NULL, snapshot_text TEXT COLLATE "BINARY" NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (revision_id) )
CREATE INDEX workflow_history ON workflow_revisions (workflow_id, registered_at_us, revision_id)

CREATE TABLE operator_definitions ( definition_id TEXT COLLATE "BINARY" NOT NULL, operator_id TEXT COLLATE "BINARY" NOT NULL, version TEXT COLLATE "BINARY" NOT NULL, definition_text TEXT COLLATE "BINARY" NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (definition_id) )
CREATE INDEX operator_versions ON operator_definitions (operator_id, version, definition_id)

CREATE TABLE user_events ( event_id TEXT COLLATE "BINARY" NOT NULL, session_id TEXT COLLATE "BINARY" NOT NULL, invocation_id TEXT COLLATE "BINARY" NOT NULL, sequence INTEGER NOT NULL, kind TEXT COLLATE "BINARY" NOT NULL, occurrence_id TEXT COLLATE "BINARY", occurred_at_us INTEGER NOT NULL, payload_text TEXT COLLATE "BINARY" NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (event_id), UNIQUE (invocation_id, sequence), CHECK (sequence >= ?) )
CREATE INDEX user_occurrence_seq ON user_events (invocation_id, occurrence_id, sequence)

CREATE TABLE checkpoints ( checkpoint_id TEXT COLLATE "BINARY" NOT NULL, root_session_id TEXT COLLATE "BINARY" NOT NULL, captured_at_us INTEGER NOT NULL, digest TEXT COLLATE "BINARY" NOT NULL, pinned BOOLEAN DEFAULT ? NOT NULL, created_reason TEXT COLLATE "BINARY" DEFAULT ? NOT NULL, checkpoint_text TEXT COLLATE "BINARY" NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (checkpoint_id), UNIQUE (digest) )
CREATE INDEX checkpoint_root_time ON checkpoints (root_session_id, captured_at_us, checkpoint_id)

CREATE TABLE sessions ( session_id TEXT COLLATE "BINARY" NOT NULL, created_at_us INTEGER, latest_invocation_id TEXT COLLATE "BINARY", durable_sequence INTEGER NOT NULL, history_start_sequence INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (session_id), CHECK (durable_sequence >= ?), CHECK (history_start_sequence >= ?) )

CREATE TABLE artifact_dependencies ( parent_hash TEXT COLLATE "BINARY" NOT NULL, slot INTEGER NOT NULL, path TEXT COLLATE "BINARY" NOT NULL, child_hash TEXT COLLATE "BINARY" NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (parent_hash, slot), CHECK (slot >= ?), CHECK (parent_hash <> child_hash), FOREIGN KEY(parent_hash) REFERENCES artifacts (hash), FOREIGN KEY(child_hash) REFERENCES artifacts (hash) )
CREATE INDEX artifact_dep_child ON artifact_dependencies (child_hash)

CREATE TABLE artifact_refs ( owner_kind TEXT COLLATE "BINARY" NOT NULL, owner_id TEXT COLLATE "BINARY" NOT NULL, slot INTEGER NOT NULL, path TEXT COLLATE "BINARY" NOT NULL, artifact_hash TEXT COLLATE "BINARY" NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (owner_kind, owner_id, slot), CHECK (owner_kind IN (?,?,?,?,?)), CHECK (slot >= ?), FOREIGN KEY(artifact_hash) REFERENCES artifacts (hash) )
CREATE INDEX artifact_ref_hash ON artifact_refs (artifact_hash)

CREATE TABLE runtime_events ( event_id TEXT COLLATE "BINARY" NOT NULL, session_id TEXT COLLATE "BINARY" NOT NULL, invocation_id TEXT COLLATE "BINARY", sequence INTEGER NOT NULL, event_name TEXT COLLATE "BINARY" NOT NULL, occurred_at_us INTEGER NOT NULL, store_order INTEGER NOT NULL, schema_version INTEGER NOT NULL, operator_definition_id TEXT COLLATE "BINARY", payload_text TEXT COLLATE "BINARY" NOT NULL, delta_text TEXT COLLATE "BINARY", PRIMARY KEY (event_id), UNIQUE (session_id, sequence), UNIQUE (store_order), CHECK (sequence >= ?), CHECK (store_order >= ?), CHECK (operator_definition_id IS NULL OR event_name IN (?,?)), FOREIGN KEY(operator_definition_id) REFERENCES operator_definitions (definition_id) )
CREATE INDEX runtime_invocation_order ON runtime_events (invocation_id, store_order)
CREATE INDEX runtime_invocation_seq ON runtime_events (invocation_id, sequence)

CREATE TABLE checkpoint_sessions ( checkpoint_id TEXT COLLATE "BINARY" NOT NULL, session_id TEXT COLLATE "BINARY" NOT NULL, invocation_id TEXT COLLATE "BINARY", workflow_revision_id TEXT COLLATE "BINARY", sequence INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (checkpoint_id, session_id), CHECK (sequence >= ?), FOREIGN KEY(checkpoint_id) REFERENCES checkpoints (checkpoint_id), FOREIGN KEY(workflow_revision_id) REFERENCES workflow_revisions (revision_id) )
CREATE INDEX checkpoint_session_position ON checkpoint_sessions (session_id, sequence, checkpoint_id)

CREATE TABLE invocations ( invocation_id TEXT COLLATE "BINARY" NOT NULL, updated_store_order INTEGER NOT NULL, session_id TEXT COLLATE "BINARY" NOT NULL, workflow_revision_id TEXT COLLATE "BINARY" NOT NULL, entry_node_id TEXT COLLATE "BINARY" NOT NULL, status TEXT COLLATE "BINARY", pending_outcome TEXT COLLATE "BINARY", control_state TEXT COLLATE "BINARY", recovery_count INTEGER, last_recovery_id TEXT COLLATE "BINARY", recovery_pending BOOLEAN, started_at_us INTEGER, completed_at_us INTEGER, last_sequence INTEGER NOT NULL, root_invocation_id TEXT COLLATE "BINARY" NOT NULL, parent_invocation_id TEXT COLLATE "BINARY", parent_occurrence_id TEXT COLLATE "BINARY", creation_id TEXT COLLATE "BINARY", unit_index INTEGER, ownership_phase TEXT COLLATE "BINARY", input_ref JSON, output_ref JSON, error_ref JSON, error_type TEXT COLLATE "BINARY", error_code TEXT COLLATE "BINARY", PRIMARY KEY (invocation_id), CHECK (status IS NULL OR status IN (?,?,?,?,?,?,?)), CHECK (pending_outcome IS NULL OR pending_outcome IN (?,?,?)), CHECK (ownership_phase IS NULL OR ownership_phase IN (?,?,?,?,?)), CHECK (unit_index IS NULL OR unit_index >= ?), CHECK ((parent_invocation_id IS NULL AND parent_occurrence_id IS NULL AND creation_id IS NULL AND unit_index IS NULL AND ownership_phase IS NULL) OR (parent_invocation_id IS NOT NULL AND parent_occurrence_id IS NOT NULL AND creation_id IS NOT NULL AND unit_index IS NOT NULL AND ownership_phase IS NOT NULL)), CHECK (parent_invocation_id IS NOT NULL OR root_invocation_id = invocation_id), UNIQUE (parent_invocation_id, creation_id, unit_index), FOREIGN KEY(root_invocation_id) REFERENCES invocations (invocation_id), CONSTRAINT fk_invocation_parent_occurrence FOREIGN KEY(parent_invocation_id, parent_occurrence_id) REFERENCES node_executions (invocation_id, occurrence_id), FOREIGN KEY(session_id) REFERENCES sessions (session_id), FOREIGN KEY(workflow_revision_id) REFERENCES workflow_revisions (revision_id) )
CREATE INDEX invocation_session_time ON invocations (session_id, started_at_us, invocation_id)
CREATE INDEX invocation_root_update ON invocations (root_invocation_id, updated_store_order)
CREATE INDEX invocation_workflow_time ON invocations (workflow_revision_id, started_at_us, invocation_id)
CREATE INDEX invocation_parent ON invocations (parent_invocation_id, unit_index, invocation_id)
CREATE INDEX invocation_root ON invocations (root_invocation_id, invocation_id)
CREATE INDEX invocation_status_time ON invocations (status, started_at_us, invocation_id)

CREATE TABLE node_executions ( invocation_id TEXT COLLATE "BINARY" NOT NULL, occurrence_id TEXT COLLATE "BINARY" NOT NULL, updated_store_order INTEGER NOT NULL, ordinal INTEGER NOT NULL, activations JSON NOT NULL, node_id TEXT COLLATE "BINARY" NOT NULL, scope JSON NOT NULL, status TEXT COLLATE "BINARY" NOT NULL, phase TEXT COLLATE "BINARY", ready_at_us INTEGER, started_at_us INTEGER, completed_at_us INTEGER, recovery_attempts INTEGER NOT NULL, input_ref JSON, output_ref JSON, metrics_ref JSON, error_ref JSON, error_type TEXT COLLATE "BINARY", error_code TEXT COLLATE "BINARY", error_phase TEXT COLLATE "BINARY", PRIMARY KEY (invocation_id, occurrence_id), CHECK (status IN (?,?,?,?,?,?,?)), CHECK (recovery_attempts >= ?), FOREIGN KEY(invocation_id) REFERENCES invocations (invocation_id) )
CREATE INDEX node_updates ON node_executions (invocation_id, updated_store_order)
CREATE INDEX node_statistics ON node_executions (node_id, status, started_at_us, invocation_id)
CREATE INDEX node_ordinal ON node_executions (invocation_id, node_id, ordinal)

CREATE TABLE graph_changes ( event_id TEXT COLLATE "BINARY" NOT NULL, change_index INTEGER NOT NULL, session_id TEXT COLLATE "BINARY" NOT NULL, invocation_id TEXT COLLATE "BINARY" NOT NULL, sequence INTEGER NOT NULL, store_order INTEGER NOT NULL, occurred_at_us INTEGER NOT NULL, entity_type TEXT COLLATE "BINARY" NOT NULL, entity_id TEXT COLLATE "BINARY" NOT NULL, change JSON NOT NULL, duration_ns INTEGER, error_type TEXT COLLATE "BINARY", error_code TEXT COLLATE "BINARY", PRIMARY KEY (event_id, change_index), CHECK (entity_type IN (?,?,?,?,?)), CHECK (change_index >= ?), CHECK (duration_ns IS NULL OR duration_ns >= ?), FOREIGN KEY(event_id) REFERENCES runtime_events (event_id), FOREIGN KEY(invocation_id) REFERENCES invocations (invocation_id) )
CREATE INDEX graph_updates ON graph_changes (invocation_id, store_order, change_index)
CREATE INDEX graph_edge_order ON graph_changes (invocation_id, JSON_EXTRACT(change, ?), store_order)
CREATE INDEX graph_entity_history ON graph_changes (invocation_id, entity_type, entity_id, sequence, change_index)
CREATE INDEX graph_replay ON graph_changes (invocation_id, sequence, change_index)

CREATE TABLE operator_calls ( invocation_id TEXT COLLATE "BINARY" NOT NULL, call_id TEXT COLLATE "BINARY" NOT NULL, updated_store_order INTEGER NOT NULL, occurrence_id TEXT COLLATE "BINARY" NOT NULL, operator_id TEXT COLLATE "BINARY" NOT NULL, operator_definition_id TEXT COLLATE "BINARY", unit_index INTEGER NOT NULL, status TEXT COLLATE "BINARY" NOT NULL, started_at_us INTEGER NOT NULL, completed_at_us INTEGER, queue_duration_ns INTEGER NOT NULL, execution_duration_ns INTEGER, input_ref JSON, output_ref JSON, error_ref JSON, error_type TEXT COLLATE "BINARY", error_code TEXT COLLATE "BINARY", PRIMARY KEY (invocation_id, call_id), FOREIGN KEY(invocation_id, occurrence_id) REFERENCES node_executions (invocation_id, occurrence_id), CHECK (status IN (?,?,?,?,?)), CHECK (unit_index >= ?), CHECK (queue_duration_ns >= ?), CHECK (execution_duration_ns IS NULL OR execution_duration_ns >= ?), FOREIGN KEY(invocation_id) REFERENCES invocations (invocation_id), FOREIGN KEY(operator_definition_id) REFERENCES operator_definitions (definition_id) )
CREATE INDEX call_occurrence ON operator_calls (invocation_id, occurrence_id, unit_index)
CREATE INDEX operator_statistics ON operator_calls (operator_id, status, started_at_us, invocation_id)
CREATE INDEX call_updates ON operator_calls (invocation_id, updated_store_order)

CREATE TABLE waits ( invocation_id TEXT COLLATE "BINARY" NOT NULL, wait_id TEXT COLLATE "BINARY" NOT NULL, updated_store_order INTEGER NOT NULL, occurrence_id TEXT COLLATE "BINARY" NOT NULL, kind TEXT COLLATE "BINARY" NOT NULL, status TEXT COLLATE "BINARY" NOT NULL, created_at_us INTEGER NOT NULL, resumed_at_us INTEGER, deadline_at_us INTEGER, request_ref JSON, response_ref JSON, PRIMARY KEY (invocation_id, wait_id), FOREIGN KEY(invocation_id, occurrence_id) REFERENCES node_executions (invocation_id, occurrence_id), CHECK (status IN (?,?,?)), FOREIGN KEY(invocation_id) REFERENCES invocations (invocation_id) )
CREATE INDEX invocation_wait_status ON waits (invocation_id, status, wait_id)
CREATE INDEX wait_updates ON waits (invocation_id, updated_store_order)
CREATE INDEX wait_deadline ON waits (status, deadline_at_us, invocation_id)

CREATE TABLE edge_evaluations ( event_id TEXT COLLATE "BINARY" NOT NULL, result_index INTEGER NOT NULL, invocation_id TEXT COLLATE "BINARY" NOT NULL, source_occurrence_id TEXT COLLATE "BINARY" NOT NULL, edge_id TEXT COLLATE "BINARY" NOT NULL, source_status TEXT COLLATE "BINARY" NOT NULL, condition_result BOOLEAN NOT NULL, duration_ns INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (event_id, result_index), CHECK (source_status IN (?,?)), CHECK (result_index >= ?), CHECK (duration_ns >= ?), FOREIGN KEY(invocation_id, source_occurrence_id) REFERENCES node_executions (invocation_id, occurrence_id), FOREIGN KEY(event_id) REFERENCES runtime_events (event_id), FOREIGN KEY(invocation_id) REFERENCES invocations (invocation_id) )
CREATE INDEX edge_statistics ON edge_evaluations (edge_id, source_status, invocation_id)
CREATE INDEX edge_source_lookup ON edge_evaluations (invocation_id, source_occurrence_id, source_status)

CREATE TABLE persistence_meta ( id INTEGER NOT NULL, format_version INTEGER NOT NULL, projection_version INTEGER NOT NULL, last_store_order INTEGER NOT NULL, store_id TEXT COLLATE "BINARY" NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (id), CHECK (id = ?) )

CREATE TABLE artifacts ( hash TEXT COLLATE "BINARY" NOT NULL, value_type TEXT COLLATE "BINARY" NOT NULL, logical_bytes INTEGER NOT NULL, body BLOB NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (hash), CHECK (value_type IN (?,?,?)), CHECK (logical_bytes >= ?) )

CREATE TABLE workflow_revisions ( revision_id TEXT COLLATE "BINARY" NOT NULL, workflow_id TEXT COLLATE "BINARY" NOT NULL, workflow_version TEXT COLLATE "BINARY" NOT NULL, definition_hash TEXT COLLATE "BINARY" NOT NULL, registered_at_us INTEGER NOT NULL, snapshot_text TEXT COLLATE "BINARY" NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (revision_id) )
CREATE INDEX workflow_history ON workflow_revisions (workflow_id, registered_at_us, revision_id)

CREATE TABLE operator_definitions ( definition_id TEXT COLLATE "BINARY" NOT NULL, operator_id TEXT COLLATE "BINARY" NOT NULL, version TEXT COLLATE "BINARY" NOT NULL, definition_text TEXT COLLATE "BINARY" NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (definition_id) )
CREATE INDEX operator_versions ON operator_definitions (operator_id, version, definition_id)

CREATE TABLE user_events ( event_id TEXT COLLATE "BINARY" NOT NULL, session_id TEXT COLLATE "BINARY" NOT NULL, invocation_id TEXT COLLATE "BINARY" NOT NULL, sequence INTEGER NOT NULL, kind TEXT COLLATE "BINARY" NOT NULL, occurrence_id TEXT COLLATE "BINARY", occurred_at_us INTEGER NOT NULL, payload_text TEXT COLLATE "BINARY" NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (event_id), UNIQUE (invocation_id, sequence), CHECK (sequence >= ?) )
CREATE INDEX user_occurrence_seq ON user_events (invocation_id, occurrence_id, sequence)

CREATE TABLE checkpoints ( checkpoint_id TEXT COLLATE "BINARY" NOT NULL, root_session_id TEXT COLLATE "BINARY" NOT NULL, captured_at_us INTEGER NOT NULL, digest TEXT COLLATE "BINARY" NOT NULL, pinned BOOLEAN DEFAULT ? NOT NULL, created_reason TEXT COLLATE "BINARY" DEFAULT ? NOT NULL, checkpoint_text TEXT COLLATE "BINARY" NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (checkpoint_id), UNIQUE (digest) )
CREATE INDEX checkpoint_root_time ON checkpoints (root_session_id, captured_at_us, checkpoint_id)

CREATE TABLE sessions ( session_id TEXT COLLATE "BINARY" NOT NULL, created_at_us INTEGER, latest_invocation_id TEXT COLLATE "BINARY", durable_sequence INTEGER NOT NULL, history_start_sequence INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (session_id), CHECK (durable_sequence >= ?), CHECK (history_start_sequence >= ?) )

CREATE TABLE artifact_dependencies ( parent_hash TEXT COLLATE "BINARY" NOT NULL, slot INTEGER NOT NULL, path TEXT COLLATE "BINARY" NOT NULL, child_hash TEXT COLLATE "BINARY" NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (parent_hash, slot), CHECK (slot >= ?), CHECK (parent_hash <> child_hash), FOREIGN KEY(parent_hash) REFERENCES artifacts (hash), FOREIGN KEY(child_hash) REFERENCES artifacts (hash) )
CREATE INDEX artifact_dep_child ON artifact_dependencies (child_hash)

CREATE TABLE artifact_refs ( owner_kind TEXT COLLATE "BINARY" NOT NULL, owner_id TEXT COLLATE "BINARY" NOT NULL, slot INTEGER NOT NULL, path TEXT COLLATE "BINARY" NOT NULL, artifact_hash TEXT COLLATE "BINARY" NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (owner_kind, owner_id, slot), CHECK (owner_kind IN (?,?,?,?,?)), CHECK (slot >= ?), FOREIGN KEY(artifact_hash) REFERENCES artifacts (hash) )
CREATE INDEX artifact_ref_hash ON artifact_refs (artifact_hash)

CREATE TABLE runtime_events ( event_id TEXT COLLATE "BINARY" NOT NULL, session_id TEXT COLLATE "BINARY" NOT NULL, invocation_id TEXT COLLATE "BINARY", sequence INTEGER NOT NULL, event_name TEXT COLLATE "BINARY" NOT NULL, occurred_at_us INTEGER NOT NULL, store_order INTEGER NOT NULL, schema_version INTEGER NOT NULL, operator_definition_id TEXT COLLATE "BINARY", payload_text TEXT COLLATE "BINARY" NOT NULL, delta_text TEXT COLLATE "BINARY", PRIMARY KEY (event_id), UNIQUE (session_id, sequence), UNIQUE (store_order), CHECK (sequence >= ?), CHECK (store_order >= ?), CHECK (operator_definition_id IS NULL OR event_name IN (?,?)), FOREIGN KEY(operator_definition_id) REFERENCES operator_definitions (definition_id) )
CREATE INDEX runtime_invocation_seq ON runtime_events (invocation_id, sequence)
CREATE INDEX runtime_invocation_order ON runtime_events (invocation_id, store_order)

CREATE TABLE checkpoint_sessions ( checkpoint_id TEXT COLLATE "BINARY" NOT NULL, session_id TEXT COLLATE "BINARY" NOT NULL, invocation_id TEXT COLLATE "BINARY", workflow_revision_id TEXT COLLATE "BINARY", sequence INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (checkpoint_id, session_id), CHECK (sequence >= ?), FOREIGN KEY(checkpoint_id) REFERENCES checkpoints (checkpoint_id), FOREIGN KEY(workflow_revision_id) REFERENCES workflow_revisions (revision_id) )
CREATE INDEX checkpoint_session_position ON checkpoint_sessions (session_id, sequence, checkpoint_id)

CREATE TABLE invocations ( invocation_id TEXT COLLATE "BINARY" NOT NULL, updated_store_order INTEGER NOT NULL, session_id TEXT COLLATE "BINARY" NOT NULL, workflow_revision_id TEXT COLLATE "BINARY" NOT NULL, entry_node_id TEXT COLLATE "BINARY" NOT NULL, status TEXT COLLATE "BINARY", pending_outcome TEXT COLLATE "BINARY", control_state TEXT COLLATE "BINARY", recovery_count INTEGER, last_recovery_id TEXT COLLATE "BINARY", recovery_pending BOOLEAN, started_at_us INTEGER, completed_at_us INTEGER, last_sequence INTEGER NOT NULL, root_invocation_id TEXT COLLATE "BINARY" NOT NULL, parent_invocation_id TEXT COLLATE "BINARY", parent_occurrence_id TEXT COLLATE "BINARY", creation_id TEXT COLLATE "BINARY", unit_index INTEGER, ownership_phase TEXT COLLATE "BINARY", input_ref JSON, output_ref JSON, error_ref JSON, error_type TEXT COLLATE "BINARY", error_code TEXT COLLATE "BINARY", PRIMARY KEY (invocation_id), CHECK (status IS NULL OR status IN (?,?,?,?,?,?,?)), CHECK (pending_outcome IS NULL OR pending_outcome IN (?,?,?)), CHECK (ownership_phase IS NULL OR ownership_phase IN (?,?,?,?,?)), CHECK (unit_index IS NULL OR unit_index >= ?), CHECK ((parent_invocation_id IS NULL AND parent_occurrence_id IS NULL AND creation_id IS NULL AND unit_index IS NULL AND ownership_phase IS NULL) OR (parent_invocation_id IS NOT NULL AND parent_occurrence_id IS NOT NULL AND creation_id IS NOT NULL AND unit_index IS NOT NULL AND ownership_phase IS NOT NULL)), CHECK (parent_invocation_id IS NOT NULL OR root_invocation_id = invocation_id), UNIQUE (parent_invocation_id, creation_id, unit_index), FOREIGN KEY(root_invocation_id) REFERENCES invocations (invocation_id), CONSTRAINT fk_invocation_parent_occurrence FOREIGN KEY(parent_invocation_id, parent_occurrence_id) REFERENCES node_executions (invocation_id, occurrence_id), FOREIGN KEY(session_id) REFERENCES sessions (session_id), FOREIGN KEY(workflow_revision_id) REFERENCES workflow_revisions (revision_id) )
CREATE INDEX invocation_workflow_time ON invocations (workflow_revision_id, started_at_us, invocation_id)
CREATE INDEX invocation_parent ON invocations (parent_invocation_id, unit_index, invocation_id)
CREATE INDEX invocation_root ON invocations (root_invocation_id, invocation_id)
CREATE INDEX invocation_status_time ON invocations (status, started_at_us, invocation_id)
CREATE INDEX invocation_session_time ON invocations (session_id, started_at_us, invocation_id)
CREATE INDEX invocation_root_update ON invocations (root_invocation_id, updated_store_order)

CREATE TABLE node_executions ( invocation_id TEXT COLLATE "BINARY" NOT NULL, occurrence_id TEXT COLLATE "BINARY" NOT NULL, updated_store_order INTEGER NOT NULL, ordinal INTEGER NOT NULL, activations JSON NOT NULL, node_id TEXT COLLATE "BINARY" NOT NULL, scope JSON NOT NULL, status TEXT COLLATE "BINARY" NOT NULL, phase TEXT COLLATE "BINARY", ready_at_us INTEGER, started_at_us INTEGER, completed_at_us INTEGER, recovery_attempts INTEGER NOT NULL, input_ref JSON, output_ref JSON, metrics_ref JSON, error_ref JSON, error_type TEXT COLLATE "BINARY", error_code TEXT COLLATE "BINARY", error_phase TEXT COLLATE "BINARY", PRIMARY KEY (invocation_id, occurrence_id), CHECK (status IN (?,?,?,?,?,?,?)), CHECK (recovery_attempts >= ?), FOREIGN KEY(invocation_id) REFERENCES invocations (invocation_id) )
CREATE INDEX node_ordinal ON node_executions (invocation_id, node_id, ordinal)
CREATE INDEX node_statistics ON node_executions (node_id, status, started_at_us, invocation_id)
CREATE INDEX node_updates ON node_executions (invocation_id, updated_store_order)

CREATE TABLE graph_changes ( event_id TEXT COLLATE "BINARY" NOT NULL, change_index INTEGER NOT NULL, session_id TEXT COLLATE "BINARY" NOT NULL, invocation_id TEXT COLLATE "BINARY" NOT NULL, sequence INTEGER NOT NULL, store_order INTEGER NOT NULL, occurred_at_us INTEGER NOT NULL, entity_type TEXT COLLATE "BINARY" NOT NULL, entity_id TEXT COLLATE "BINARY" NOT NULL, change JSON NOT NULL, duration_ns INTEGER, error_type TEXT COLLATE "BINARY", error_code TEXT COLLATE "BINARY", PRIMARY KEY (event_id, change_index), CHECK (entity_type IN (?,?,?,?,?)), CHECK (change_index >= ?), CHECK (duration_ns IS NULL OR duration_ns >= ?), FOREIGN KEY(event_id) REFERENCES runtime_events (event_id), FOREIGN KEY(invocation_id) REFERENCES invocations (invocation_id) )
CREATE INDEX graph_entity_history ON graph_changes (invocation_id, entity_type, entity_id, sequence, change_index)
CREATE INDEX graph_updates ON graph_changes (invocation_id, store_order, change_index)
CREATE INDEX graph_replay ON graph_changes (invocation_id, sequence, change_index)
CREATE INDEX graph_edge_order ON graph_changes (invocation_id, JSON_EXTRACT(change, ?), store_order)

CREATE TABLE operator_calls ( invocation_id TEXT COLLATE "BINARY" NOT NULL, call_id TEXT COLLATE "BINARY" NOT NULL, updated_store_order INTEGER NOT NULL, occurrence_id TEXT COLLATE "BINARY" NOT NULL, operator_id TEXT COLLATE "BINARY" NOT NULL, operator_definition_id TEXT COLLATE "BINARY", unit_index INTEGER NOT NULL, status TEXT COLLATE "BINARY" NOT NULL, started_at_us INTEGER NOT NULL, completed_at_us INTEGER, queue_duration_ns INTEGER NOT NULL, execution_duration_ns INTEGER, input_ref JSON, output_ref JSON, error_ref JSON, error_type TEXT COLLATE "BINARY", error_code TEXT COLLATE "BINARY", PRIMARY KEY (invocation_id, call_id), FOREIGN KEY(invocation_id, occurrence_id) REFERENCES node_executions (invocation_id, occurrence_id), CHECK (status IN (?,?,?,?,?)), CHECK (unit_index >= ?), CHECK (queue_duration_ns >= ?), CHECK (execution_duration_ns IS NULL OR execution_duration_ns >= ?), FOREIGN KEY(invocation_id) REFERENCES invocations (invocation_id), FOREIGN KEY(operator_definition_id) REFERENCES operator_definitions (definition_id) )
CREATE INDEX call_updates ON operator_calls (invocation_id, updated_store_order)
CREATE INDEX call_occurrence ON operator_calls (invocation_id, occurrence_id, unit_index)
CREATE INDEX operator_statistics ON operator_calls (operator_id, status, started_at_us, invocation_id)

CREATE TABLE waits ( invocation_id TEXT COLLATE "BINARY" NOT NULL, wait_id TEXT COLLATE "BINARY" NOT NULL, updated_store_order INTEGER NOT NULL, occurrence_id TEXT COLLATE "BINARY" NOT NULL, kind TEXT COLLATE "BINARY" NOT NULL, status TEXT COLLATE "BINARY" NOT NULL, created_at_us INTEGER NOT NULL, resumed_at_us INTEGER, deadline_at_us INTEGER, request_ref JSON, response_ref JSON, PRIMARY KEY (invocation_id, wait_id), FOREIGN KEY(invocation_id, occurrence_id) REFERENCES node_executions (invocation_id, occurrence_id), CHECK (status IN (?,?,?)), FOREIGN KEY(invocation_id) REFERENCES invocations (invocation_id) )
CREATE INDEX invocation_wait_status ON waits (invocation_id, status, wait_id)
CREATE INDEX wait_updates ON waits (invocation_id, updated_store_order)
CREATE INDEX wait_deadline ON waits (status, deadline_at_us, invocation_id)

CREATE TABLE edge_evaluations ( event_id TEXT COLLATE "BINARY" NOT NULL, result_index INTEGER NOT NULL, invocation_id TEXT COLLATE "BINARY" NOT NULL, source_occurrence_id TEXT COLLATE "BINARY" NOT NULL, edge_id TEXT COLLATE "BINARY" NOT NULL, source_status TEXT COLLATE "BINARY" NOT NULL, condition_result BOOLEAN NOT NULL, duration_ns INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (event_id, result_index), CHECK (source_status IN (?,?)), CHECK (result_index >= ?), CHECK (duration_ns >= ?), FOREIGN KEY(invocation_id, source_occurrence_id) REFERENCES node_executions (invocation_id, occurrence_id), FOREIGN KEY(event_id) REFERENCES runtime_events (event_id), FOREIGN KEY(invocation_id) REFERENCES invocations (invocation_id) )

CREATE TABLE checkpoints ( checkpoint_id TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL, root_session_id TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL, captured_at_us BIGINT NOT NULL, digest TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL, pinned BOOLEAN DEFAULT false NOT NULL, created_reason TEXT COLLATE "C" DEFAULT ?
